dialogues.speaker: Nishikino Reirei
dialogues.text: Huh? Wh—What are you saying all of a sudden?

dialogues.speaker: Nishikino Reirei
dialogues.text: A doctor saves lives. That's normal. Nothing more to it.

dialogues.speaker: Nishikino Reirei
dialogues.text: ...A—Anyway, just take this. Who knows, it might be of use to you at some point.
